judge_reasoning: The model's solution uses a different sequence (Khenra Charioteer, Aviary Mechanic, Longtusk Cub bounce/recast) to generate three Rhonas's Monument triggers totaling +6/+6 spread across creatures, resulting in 5 attacking creatures with trample and total power 21. Mana costs work out exactly (5 mana available, 5 needed after cost reductions). There is a minor targeting error in the writeup (attempting to target Longtusk Cub with the Monument trigger before it's on the battlefield), but this is trivially fixable by targeting any other already-present creature without changing the total power (21). Careful combat math shows that since Rhonas has deathtouch, the opponent's optimal defense (blocking the three largest non-Rhonas attackers with their toughness-4/3/2 creatures) caps damage prevention at exactly 9, guaranteeing exactly 12 damage gets through regardless of blocking assignment - exactly lethal against the opponent's 12 life. This is a valid, alternative, rules-legal path to victory.
model_solution:
1. Tap Aether Hub and pay 1 energy to add {R}. Tap two Scattered Groves for {G}{G}, one Scattered Groves for {W}, and the last Scattered Groves for {1}.
2. Cast Khenra Charioteer (cost reduced to {R}{G}). Rhonas's Monument trigger: give Greenbelt Rampager +2/+2 and trample.
3. Cast Aviary Mechanic. Rhonas's Monument trigger: give any non-Rhonas creature +2/+2 and trample (e.g. Khenra Charioteer).
4. Aviary Mechanic ETB: return Longtusk Cub to hand (Cartouche of Strength goes to the graveyard).
5. Cast Longtusk Cub (cost reduced to {G}). Rhonas's Monument trigger: give any non-Rhonas creature +2/+2 and trample (e.g. Longtusk Cub).
6. Attack with Rhonas the Indomitable, Greenbelt Rampager, Khenra Charioteer, Aviary Mechanic, and Longtusk Cub (all have trample; at least one non-Rhonas creature has power 4 or greater). Total power is 21. Regardless of blocks, at most 9 damage can be assigned to opposing creatures, so at least 12 damage gets through.
